release_read.basis: Revenue $1,235.8M against a ~$1.07B bar (+15%), non-GAAP EPS $0.94 against $0.67-0.71 (+35%), and a third FY raise to $4.4-4.6B / EPS $3.10-3.40 against ~$4.1B consensus (+10% at midpoint) into a stock down 23% in 20 sessions; larger than the Q1 beat-and-raise (+27%) on the bar, tempered by the Q2 precedent (-1.85%) and the Jupiter question the release does not address.

release.released_at_note: After the 2026-10-22 close (8-K exhibit 99.1 dated 2026-10-22; call 17:00 ET). Exact minute not read.
release.headline: Bloom Energy Reports Record Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Raises Full Year 2026 Guidance

vs_bar.note: Other bars $0.67 (SA/TradingView), $0.69 (TipRanks); Nasdaq fallback forecast $0.56 (5 estimates) from the brief.

key_line.detail: Raised to $4.4-4.6B from $3.9-4.2B (July), non-GAAP EPS $3.10-3.40 from $2.55-2.85, non-GAAP op income $960-1,030M from $800-900M. Midpoint ~10% above FY consensus (~$4.1B, Trefis). Implied Q4 ~$1.35-1.55B against ~$1.22B the street implied. No Oracle/Jupiter, backlog or 2027 commentary in the release.

guidance.detail: FY2026 revenue $4.4-4.6B vs prior $3.9-4.2B and street ~$4.1B; EPS $3.10-3.40 vs prior $2.55-2.85.

call.detail: Held last night. No transcript found; one third-party snippet (io-fund, snippet_only) cites capacity doubling to 2 GW by December 2026. What was said on Jupiter/2027 could not be established, and the overnight tape (after-hours -6.9%) suggests something in or around the call was read negatively.

public_reaction.summary: No dated 2026-10-23 analyst action or price-reaction article found in two searches; search results returned 2025-era target changes only. Headlines on the release itself are 'record quarter, third raise, S&P 500'. Retail tone not found.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 209.0 (-4.03% vs prev close 217.77), 285 prints, 29 in the last 30 minutes, last at 09:12, not stale. After-hours ended at 202.84 (-6.86%); pre-market high 226.83 (+4.2%), low 207.73. So the overnight path was up, then down hard, and the pre-market has recovered about 3 points from the after-hours low. Against a +15% release read and a 10.2% implied move this is a large undershoot of the printed numbers; the market has had a full night and the call, so part of the gap is likely call content (Jupiter/2027) I could not verify. Market slightly soft (SPY -0.4%, QQQ -0.3%). Position (entry 214.45) is about -2.5% at the reference.

thesis_check.note: Thesis was a beat over a flat $1.07B bar plus a third raise, minus Jupiter risk. Beat and raise both came in larger than the hunt sized; the tape says the Jupiter/2027 side, or AI-power sentiment, dominated overnight.

expected.open_lag_note: Active, non-stale pre-market (29 prints in 30 min) so the open should hold the -4% gap; a moderate gap against a very strong beat-and-raise, with the pre-market already climbing off the after-hours low, leans toward some fade back toward the prior close by 10:00, though the unknown call content and 172% IV make this low-confidence.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers waren veel beter dan verwacht (omzet +15% boven de verwachting, jaarprognose voor de derde keer verhoogd), maar het aandeel staat voorbeurs toch zo'n 4% lager, waarmee de positie licht verliest. Koersdalingen bij de opening na cijfers lopen vaak deels terug in het eerste half uur, en de voorbeurs herstelt al van de nabeurs-bodem; daarom niet bij de opening verkopen maar om 10:00 uur.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Zakt de voorbeurskoers voor 09:30 terug naar of onder de nabeurs-bodem rond 203, of verschijnt er een duidelijke afwaardering of slecht nieuws over Oracle/Jupiter, verkoop dan direct bij de opening.
